notes.title: MANDATORY BEFORE STARTING THE GAME!
notes.content:
When you start the game for the first time, when you just download the project, its settings will be reset to their original state and most likely some functions will not work correctly.

To avoid this problem, we STRONGLY RECOMMEND to  [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_ZtRq9_L97PyKgTLeWryS9hqcmzxh_EQ/view?usp=sharing]download [/url]the settings file and place it in the path indicated below:
[h3]C: / Users / User_Name / AppData / Local / InDreams / Saved / SaveGames[/h3]

Link to the settings file: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_ZtRq9_L97PyKgTLeWryS9hqcmzxh_EQ/view?usp=sharing

Sorry for the inconvenience!
